description: Use this when the user wants to compare the travel advice for several countries side by side, such as "compare Mexico, Colombia and Peru" or "which of these countries has the highest advisory level?". Returns: for each country the UK FCDO alert and review date and the US State Department level (1 to 4) and date, with official links. Input tips: pass 1 to 5 country names or ISO codes. Check each country's own status: one can be not_found, or ambiguous with candidates to ask the user about, while the rest are ok. If uk or us is none or unavailable for a country, report the other side and its link; do not guess. Not for: the full text of one country (use get_travel_advice) or visa rules for other passports. UK advice is for British citizens and US advice for US citizens.

countries.description: Country names in English or two-letter ISO codes, 1 to 5, such as ["Mexico", "Colombia", "PE"]. Repeats are removed.

name: compare_advisories

citizenship.description: Who each government writes for. Tell the user this.

countries.description: One entry per country asked for, in the same order. Check each entry's status: a batch can mix ok, not_found and ambiguous.

candidates.description: With status ambiguous: the places the name could mean. Ask the user which one, then call again with that exact name.

status.description: ok: see uk and us. not_found: no such country; check the spelling with the user. ambiguous: ask the user to pick one of candidates, then call again.

alertText.description: All FCDO alerts as one string of plain sentences, to quote as written. get_travel_advice returns the same sentences as a list.

reviewedAt.description: When the FCDO last reviewed the advice, as an ISO 8601 time.

status.description: ok: advice found. none: this government publishes no advisory for the place. unavailable: its source could not be read; report the other government's advice and the official link, and do not guess this one.

level.description: US advisory level: 1 exercise normal precautions, 2 increased caution, 3 reconsider travel, 4 do not travel. null when the advisory names no level.

levelText.description: The level as the State Department words it, such as "Level 2: Exercise Increased Caution".

status.description: ok: advice found. none: this government publishes no advisory for the place. unavailable: its source could not be read; report the other government's advice and the official link, and do not guess this one.

updated.description: When the State Department last updated the advisory, as an ISO 8601 time.

url.description: The US State Department advisory page.

license.description: Attribution for the UK text (Open Government Licence).

message.description: What to tell the user or do next when status is unavailable.

notice.description: The limits of this information, to pass on.

sources.description: The official sources, to link in the answer.

status.description: ok: see each country's own status. unavailable: both sources are down; try again in a few minutes and give the official links.

title: Compare travel advisories
